csv_project_name: A/E For Pritchardville / Okatie Library Branch
csv_scope_of_work: Beaufort County is soliciting qualifications from qualified design professionals to provide architectural and engineering (A/E) design services for the new Pritchardville / Okatie Library Branch. The Pritchardville / Okatie Library Branch is a planned 15,000 20,000 square foot public library intended to serve the rapidly growing southern region of Beaufort County, including Bluffton, Pritchardville, and Okatie.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering

title: A/E for Pritchardville / Okatie Library Branch
short_description: Design services for a new 15,000–20,000 square foot public library in Beaufort County.
project_scope: New public library branch planned for approximately 15,000 to 20,000 square feet, intended to serve the growing southern region of Beaufort County including Bluffton, Pritchardville, and Okatie.
services: Architectural and engineering design services; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project rather than a bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Moderate size public library of 15,000–20,000 square feet; not clearly large or structurally complex.
- Tender is for early-stage design services, which offers some strategic entry potential.
- No indication of special spans, innovative structural systems, sustainability focus, or demanding load-bearing design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. Available scope information: new public library of approximately 15,000–20,000 square feet with A/E services including architecture, interiors, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering. A realistic cost estimate is not reliable from the provided information alone because no quality standard, site conditions, structural system, or local cost basis is given.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender documents. Only the requested A/E disciplines and building size of approximately 15,000–20,000 square feet are provided, which is insufficient for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Qualified design professionals for architectural and engineering design services are requested. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Beaufort County Council, Beaufort County, South Carolina, USA. Contact: Gillian Murray. Email: gmurray@bcgov.net. Phone: 843-255-2026. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/bcgov/projects/256965/downloads
notes: Project number 062026. Target market: General Building. Mandatory pre-submittal meeting via TEAMS on 06/03/2026 at 02:00 PM EDT; invitation by email request. Questions deadline: 06/10/2026 05:00 PM EDT. Contract participation goal for Minority-Owned Business Enterprise.
